method: Astropy io.fits native WAVE/FLUX/ERR/QUAL; finite FLUX and positive finite ERR, QUAL=0. WAVE angstrom to nm. NumPy bincount averages half-open 1 nm bins centred at 380 through 780; every bin populated. CIE 1931 2 degree XYZ sum; IEC sRGB matrix, peak normalization and sRGB encoding. No interpolation or clipping.
limits: This independently checks the numerical integration of the same spectrum. It is not a second instrument or an independent calibration of the source.
